facts.fact: The NICIS CHPC service catalogue lists a Dell peta-scale HPC and GPU cluster with 30 Nvidia V100 GPU nodes and 4 PB of storage as a service, with use cases that include enabling machine learning insights.
The CHPC GPU cluster is offered free for six-month renewable periods to academic and public-interest users and for a fee to commercial users, with over 2000 users and over a billion core hours used.

systems.platform: Dell cluster, 30 Nvidia V100 GPU nodes
